validity.recommendation: Route to a human de-dup pass on the whole UBTG-1 trunk cluster (P1898, P1899, P1900, P1901, P1910, P1911, P1912): treat these as one physical Uthmaniyah-Berri Trunk Gas (UBTG-1) corridor decomposed into km-post/node segments by the OPEC ASB table, not 7 independent pipelines. Do NOT stage refs onto P1912 as a standalone line until the segmentation is adjudicated.
validity.researcher_notes: SEGMENTATION/DUPLICATE. The name 'Hawiyah-UBTG-1-km0' is not a real pipeline name — it is a node/kilometer-post label ('UBTG-1-km0' = kilometer 0 of the UBTG-1 trunk). The row is one cell of a single OPEC Annual Statistical Bulletin pipeline table for Saudi Arabia that GEM ingested row-by-row. The sibling rows prove it: P1910 'UBTG-1-km0-UBTG-1-km56' (56 km, 48 in) and P1911 'UBTG-1-km0-UBTG-1-km56 2' (56 km, 40 in) share the exact same UBTG-1-km0 node, and P1898/P1899 'UBTG-1-Berri' + P1900 'UBTG-km56-AY-1' + P1901 'UBTG-1km-Juaymah' continue the same trunk to Berri/Juaymah. P1912 is the Hawiyah->km0 leg of that one trunk system. UBTG = Uthmaniyah-Berri Trunk Gas: independent leads describe a 152 km 'UBTG-3' linking Uthmaniyah gas plant to Juaymah and Berri, and Aramco/trade descriptions of the Haradh/Hawiyah increment mention a 'new 56-inch rich gas pipeline to Uthmaniyah' — which matches P1912's 56 in / 56 km and confirms km0 of UBTG-1 sits at Uthmaniyah (Hawiyah->Uthmaniyah leg). EXISTENCE CAVEAT: the physical corridor (Hawiyah->Uthmaniyah 56-inch gas trunk in the eastern Ghawar chain) is plausibly real, but the GEM ENTITY as a distinct named pipeline has zero independent support — its only citations are OPEC ASB 2012 (p.75/p.79) and OPEC ASB 2017, which are the SAME publisher republishing the same table (not two independent sources), and neither names a 'Hawiyah-UBTG-1-km0' pipeline. GulfPub PE World Map (Saudi Arabia is its best-covered country, 20 gas features) lists NO UBTG or km-post segment at all — an independent detailed dataset does not recognize these as separate pipelines, reinforcing that the cluster is a table artifact. Corroboration cited is geographic only: Ghawar Field (north->south: Ain Dar, Shedgum, Uthmaniyah, Hawiyah, Haradh) confirms Hawiyah and Uthmaniyah are adjacent Ghawar areas, consistent with a ~56 km trunk leg.

validity.recommendation: Do not treat 56 km / 56 in as independently confirmed; both trace to the single OPEC ASB table. Note the suspicious length=diameter=56 coincidence. Leave Capacity blank (no sourced value).
validity.researcher_notes: SPEC + ATTRIBUTION check. Length 56 km and diameter 56 in derive solely from the OPEC ASB table (single non-independent source family); trade descriptions of a '56-inch rich gas pipeline to Uthmaniyah' loosely corroborate the 56-inch diameter and the Hawiyah->Uthmaniyah corridor but give no length agreement, so this does not meet the 2-independent bar. Owner/operator Saudi Aramco 100% is correct — all Master Gas System / UBTG trunk infrastructure is Aramco-owned and -operated; no JV. Fuel=Gas and gas-tracker classification are correct (this is a gas transmission trunk leg, not oil/NGL/condensate; it is a rich-gas trunk feeding Uthmaniyah for deep ethane recovery, a legitimate transmission line rather than a plant-internal or gathering line). Capacity is blank and cannot be sourced (OPEC gives none; GulfPub's 300 mmcfd is a placeholder, not a real value). Note: do NOT confuse Hawiyah Gas Plant (Ghawar, Eastern Province) with 'Al Hawiyah' near Makkah/Taif in P3961 — different place, not a duplicate.

fills.researcher_notes: No independent capacity value exists for this trunk leg. OPEC ASB (the sheet's only source) lists none; GulfPub Capacity_mmcfd=300 is a known constant placeholder, never a real capacity. Not filled — do not force a number.

routes.corridor_desc: Runs ~56 km northward through the eastern Ghawar corridor from Hawiyah Gas Plant to the km0 origin of the UBTG-1 (Uthmaniyah-Berri Trunk Gas) line at Uthmaniyah Gas Plant. Uthmaniyah lies immediately north of Hawiyah in the Ghawar chain (Ain Dar-Shedgum-Uthmaniyah-Hawiyah-Haradh, N->S), so the corridor is well-bounded in direction and length but the precise routing and the Uthmaniyah/km0 endpoint coordinate are not independently sourced. Hawiyah endpoint coordinate is approximate (Hawiyah field/plant area, ~24.80N 49.39E); Uthmaniyah endpoint left null (no defensible precise coordinate).
routes.researcher_notes: Endpoints established from: (1) the row name (Hawiyah -> UBTG-1 km0); (2) independent leads that UBTG links Uthmaniyah to Berri/Juaymah and that a 56-inch rich gas line feeds Uthmaniyah from the Haradh/Hawiyah increment, placing km0 at Uthmaniyah; (3) Ghawar Field geography confirming Hawiyah and Uthmaniyah are adjacent, ~50-60 km apart. Uthmaniyah/km0 coordinate deliberately left null (not fabricated). Corridor is a suggestion for a human routes-repo branch only.

summary: P1912 concern=duplicate (km-post segment of the one UBTG-1 Uthmaniyah-Berri trunk, co-segments P1910/P1911; whole P1898-P1901/P1910-P1912 cluster is one OPEC-ASB-table trunk) + spec caveat; existence of the named entity unsupported by any independent source (only OPEC ASB, republished; no GulfPub match).
